newest.title: How Do AI Startups Thrive After Being Caught in US-China Trade Disputes?
newest.description: How Do AI Startups Thrive After Being Caught in US-China Trade Disputes. Manus AI just secured $500 million in funding after its massive Meta deal was blocked by regulators. We’re looking at what this means for the future of independent AI agents. What we covered: • Manus AI Raises $500 Million After Blocked Meta Deal • Norway Proposes Temporary Ban on AI Glasses in Public Spaces • FCC considers loosening rules for political robocalls that include AI voices Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: Should cities ban AI-enabled smart glasses in public spaces to protect bystander privacy? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed.
